title: Bloom Target Distribution
description: Validates the checked-in generic Bloom target curve (schemas/taxonomies/bloom_target_distribution.json) AND an operator-supplied override curve passed via ED4ALL_BLOOM_DISTRIBUTION_TARGET. The target_shares map keys must be a subset of the canonical six BLOOM_LEVELS and every share must sit in [0,1]; the three band knobs (recall_ceiling / higher_order_floor / top_heavy_ceiling) are in [0,1].

target_shares.description: Per-level target share over the six canonical BLOOM_LEVELS. Keys must be a subset of BLOOM_LEVELS; values in [0,1].
